**Incident Summary: Tuesday Afternoon Sensor Outage**

**What Happened**
On Tuesday afternoon, eight sensors in the east corridor stopped sending data to the dashboard for approximately 36 minutes. Four sensors in the west corridor continued to work normally.

**Likely Trigger**
The primary cause was a network configuration change made to the Wi-Fi access point in the east corridor at 13:42. Although the password remained the same, the change to the network name prevented the east-corridor sensors from reconnecting automatically. This caused connection failures starting at 13:47. The issue was resolved
